description: This plot illustrates the "Hidden State Mean" across different layers, comparing three distinct conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines, all without markers. The blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". It begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, fluctuates slightly between 0.2 and 0.5 until layer 17, rises to roughly 0.9 at layer 19, and then exhibits a sharp increase, reaching approximately 2.6 at layer 21 before peaking at approximately 4.3 at layer 23. The orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". It starts at 0 at layer 0 and maintains a steady, near-zero trend with a very slight gradual increase, ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23. The green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Similar to the orange line, it starts at 0 at layer 0 and remains relatively flat and close to zero across the entire x-axis, also ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
